description:
## Summary

A Nextflow plugin to work with validation of pipeline parameters and sample sheets. This plugin provides functionality for Nextflow pipelines to validate parameters against a schema, validate sample sheet contents, and manage parameter metadata. Key features include:

- Print usage instructions to the terminal (for use with `--help`)
- Print log output showing parameters with non-default values
- Validate supplied parameters against the pipeline schema
- Validate the contents of supplied sample sheet files
- Create a type-casted list from a parsed sample sheet

Supported sample sheet formats are CSV, TSV, JSON and YAML.

## Get Started

Declare the plugin in your Nextflow pipeline configuration file:

```groovy title="nextflow.config"
plugins {
  id 'nf-schema@2.7.2'
}
```

Include the plugin helper functions into your Nextflow pipeline:

```groovy title="main.nf"
include { validateParameters; paramsSummaryLog; samplesheetToList } from 'plugin/nf-schema'

// Validate input parameters
validateParameters()

// Print summary of supplied parameters
log.info paramsSummaryLog(workflow)

// Create a new channel of metadata from a sample sheet passed to the pipeline through the --input parameter
ch_input = Channel.fromList(samplesheetToList(params.input, "assets/schema_input.json"))
```

Or enable the creation of the help message (using `--help`) in the configuration file:

```groovy title="nextflow.config"
validation {
  help {
    enabled = true
  }
}
```

**Requirements:**
- Java 17 or later
- Nextflow 25.10.0 or later

## Examples

```groovy title="main.nf"
include { validateParameters; paramsSummaryLog; samplesheetToList } from 'plugin/nf-schema'

// Validate input parameters
validateParameters()

// Print summary of supplied parameters
log.info paramsSummaryLog(workflow)

// Create a new channel of metadata from a sample sheet passed to the pipeline through the --input parameter
ch_input = Channel.fromList(samplesheetToList(params.input, "assets/schema_input.json"))
```

spec.name: validation
parametersSchema
spec.description: The JSON schema file to use for parameter validation.

spec.name: defaultIgnoreParams
spec.description: A list of default parameters to ignore during validation. This option should only be used by pipeline developers.

spec.name: allowParamsSubstitution
spec.description: Allow substitution of parameters in the samplesheet.

spec.name: summary
beforeText
spec.description: The text to show before the summary message.

spec.name: afterText
spec.description: The text to show after the summary message.

spec.name: hideParams
spec.description: A list of parameters to hide in the summary message.

spec.name: maskSubpaths
spec.description: A list of subpaths to mask from path values.

spec.name: mask
spec.description: Mask value, when replacing bucket names or subpaths. Defaults to [** masked **].
Configuration scope for the parameter summary.

spec.name: help
showHidden
spec.description: Show hidden parameters in the help message.

spec.name: enumLength
spec.description:
The maximum length in characters of the enum preview in the help message.
This defaults to the length of the terminal window specified by the `COLUMNS` environment variable
or 100 characters if this variable hasn't been set.
If the enum preview exceeds this length, it will be truncated.
Set this option to -1 to disable the enum preview truncation.

spec.name: beforeText
spec.description: The text to show before the help message.

spec.name: fullParameter
spec.description: The parameter to use to show the full help message.

spec.name: afterText
spec.description: The text to show after the help message.

spec.name: command
spec.description: An example command of how to run the pipeline.

spec.name: showHiddenParameter
spec.description: The parameter to use to show hidden parameters in the help message.

spec.name: shortParameter
spec.description: The parameter to use to show the short help message.
Configuration scope for the help message.

spec.name: monochromeLogs
spec.description: Toggle monochrome logs. In monochrome mode, the logs will not be colored.

spec.name: showHiddenParams
spec.description:
Show hidden parameters in the help message.
This is deprecated, please use `validation.help.showHidden` or the `--showHidden` parameter instead.

spec.name: lenientMode
spec.description:
Toggle lenient mode. In lenient mode, the validation of types will be more lenient
(e.g. an integer will pass as a string type).

spec.name: logging
unrecognisedParams
spec.description: Define the logging level of unrecognised parameters. Defaults to `warn`.

spec.name: unrecognisedHeaders
spec.description: Define the logging level of unrecognised headers that are found in the samplesheets. Defaults to `warn`.
Configuration scope for the logging of the validation plugin.

spec.name: maxErrValSize
spec.description:
Maximum size of the value shown in the error message.
If the value is larger than this threshold, it will be truncated. Set to -1 to disable truncation.

spec.name: ignoreParams
spec.description: A list of parameters to ignore during validation.
The `validation` scope allows you to configure the `nf-schema` plugin.
